description: Land Development and Drainage System Improvement Project related to the Rathgama Town Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2026-11-02 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body:
- Due to the absence of a properly designed drainage system in the surrounding areas of the Rathgama Town, a service town located between the Galle and Hikkaduwa with tourist attraction in the Southern Province, roads and surrounding areas are frequently inundated several times a year. To address this issue, the Urban Development Authority has planned to implement a project for the development of the new Rathgama town. The Cabinet approved a proposal made by the Minister of Transport, Highways, and Urban Development to implement the relevant Land Development and Drainage System Improvement Project in accordance with the plans of the said Town Development Project through the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation at an estimated cost of Rs. 3,380.22 million (inclusive of Value Added Tax), during the period of 2027 2029 with the following components:

* Creation of a water pond and water retention areas within a land area of approximately 13 acres of approximately 24.5-acre paddy land (abandoned) which has been acquired by the Sri Lanka Land Development Corporation situated between Rathgama Dodangoda Road and Wijerathna Road, and development of the remaining portions of the land. 

* Development of the canal banks, construction of the maintenance access road, improvement of the drainage system and development of the remaining land portions by acquiring approximately 1.5 acres in the lower section of the 24.5-acre said paddy land to ensure the proper diversion of excess rainwater into the Rathgama Lagoon.
